system.instructionsTitle: How to get your SolarEdge API Key and Site ID
system.instructionStep1Title: Step 1: Log in to the SolarEdge Monitoring Portal
system.instructionStep1Desc: Go to {link} and sign in with your SolarEdge account credentials. This is the same account you use to monitor your solar system.
system.instructionStep2Desc: Once logged in, click on the "Admin" menu in the top navigation bar, then select "Site Access". On this page, find and click the "API Access" section.
system.instructionStep3Title: Step 3: Generate or copy your API Key
system.instructionStep3Desc: If you haven't generated an API key before, you'll need to acknowledge the SolarEdge API Terms & Conditions. After that, your API key will be displayed. Copy it and paste it in the field above.
system.instructionStep4Desc: Your Site ID is a numeric identifier for your solar installation. You can find it in the URL bar when viewing your site on the monitoring portal — look for "siteId=" followed by a number (e.g. siteId=1234567). Alternatively, it's shown on the site's Dashboard page under the site name.
